text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! There you are,<n>Ayabe! Happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't bother me. You being around<n>always attracts
unwanted attention.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is my presence too dazzling for<n>you? But I must
ask you to bear with<n>me, just for today!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For I am here to give you a beautiful a<n>cappella
performance with Doto! And<n>you get a VIP seat!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, let us drink! ♪ To you, who were<n>born into my
shining wooorld. ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you—c-cut it out! That's<n>enough already.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, let us drink! ♪ Raise a glass in<n>celebration of
this wonderful daaay. ♪
